name: Baro Ki'Teer arrives
help: Hear when a new visit begins. Relay details appear in the desktop alert.
text: Operator. Baro Ki'Teer has arrived. His wares await at the relay. Consult live activities for the location.

name: Baro leaves in 30 minutes
help: One reminder near the end of his visit.
text: Operator. Baro Ki'Teer departs in approximately thirty minutes. Review his wares before the transmission ends.

name: New daily Sortie
help: Hear when a new Sortie rotation is confirmed by the API.
text: Operator. A new daily Sortie is available. Review the missions and modifiers in live activities.

name: New weekly Archon Hunt
help: Hear when a new Archon Hunt rotation is available.
text: Operator. A new weekly Archon Hunt is available. Prepare your arsenal and review the hunt in live activities.

name: Steel Path incursions refresh
help: Hear when the daily incursion timer rolls over.
text: Operator. The daily Steel Path incursion rotation has refreshed. Check navigation for the available missions.

name: Nightwave weekly challenges refresh
help: Tracks weekly Acts, rather than the Nightwave season timer.
text: Operator. Nightwave weekly challenges have refreshed. Review the new acts and plan your standing.
